chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from one of our companions, from Abu Al-Sabbah Al-Kinani, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who excretes in the Kaaba with an excretion, would be killed.

key_terms.أَحْدَثَ: He caused a new event, specifically referring to defecation here
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: The Kaaba, the sacred house in Mecca

ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for defecating in the Kaaba according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), linking the physical impurity of defecation (hadath) within the Kaaba to the capital punishment of stoning (rajm), a penalty traditionally associated with adultery but applied here due to the sanctity of the space. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Kaaba as a sacred sanctuary (haram) where specific acts of defilement incur severe, immediate retribution to preserve its spiritual purity.
